Open shaped liners and finite single-owner receiving bows replace sleeve backing hierarchy; no circular cuff or hanging flight train.

Existing motion APIs; no src edit
limits: Actual rendered whole-wing identity is the first gate; interowner clearances and support attachment remain to be measured after that gate.
Finite mechanical proposal; no physical simulation, continuous collision proof or exact dimensions from art.
